title: Hexad for Adults: 6 Operations
subtitle: Universal cognitive taxonomy stripped of narrative skin
key_concept: Six verb-based thinking operations (ORGANIZE, OBSERVE, OPTIMIZE, STRUCTURE, SEQUENCE, CONNECT) as a standalone adult tool
visual_metaphor: A hexagonal gear system with six interlocking cogs, each labeled with an operation, glowing amber against dark stone
highlights: Born from Resonance Engine's Golden Rule: characters teach thinking modes, not subjects
De Bono comparison: his Hats are perspectives (2 moods), these are all verbs/operations
why_it_matters: Establishes a universal, non-narrative cognitive framework for adults, expanding the Cathedral's reach beyond children
zone_change: New territory: Adult Cognitive Operations — a bridge between children's Hexad and professional thinking tools
